# YouTube Video Transcript

The Apify actor [`starvibe/youtube-video-transcript`](https://apify.com/starvibe/youtube-video-transcript) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.94**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

This Apify Actor extracts full transcripts (with timestamps) and metadata from YouTube videos, including title, description, upload date, views, likes, channel info, and duration

## Pricing

Pay per event — result $0.005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/starvibe/youtube-video-transcript) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/starvibe-youtube-video-transcript@0.0.94#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `youtube_url` | string |  |  | YouTube Video URL — Enter a valid YouTube video URL (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=video_id, https://youtu.be/video_id, or https://www.youtube.com/shorts/video_id). Use this for fetching a single video, paired with 'language' for transcript. Do not combine with channel filtering fields. |
| `language` | string |  |  | Transcript language (ISO 639-1) — Language of the subtitles in ISO 639-1 format, e.g., `en`, `fr`. Applicable to both youtube_url and channel_url. Leave blank for default language. |
| `channel_url` | string |  |  | YouTube Channel URL — Enter a valid YouTube channel URL (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx or https://www.youtube.com/@channelhandle). Use this to fetch videos from the channel, paired with 'max_videos', 'start_date', and 'end_date' for limiting and filtering results. |
| `max_videos` | integer |  | `10` | Max Videos to Fetch — Maximum number of videos to fetch from the channel (optional, default: 10, range: 1 to 200). Only applicable and used with channel_url; ignored for youtube_url. Combine with start_date/end_date for filtered results. |
| `start_date` | string |  |  | Start Date — Start date for filtering videos by upload date (format: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601, optional). Only applicable and used with channel_url; ignored for youtube_url. Videos uploaded on or after this date will be fetched. |
| `end_date` | string |  |  | End Date — End date for filtering videos by upload date (format: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601, optional). Only applicable and used with channel_url; ignored for youtube_url. Videos uploaded on or before this date will be fetched. |
| `include_transcript_text` | boolean |  | `false` | Include Transcript (w/o timestamps) — Include the full transcript as a plain string without timestamps (transcript_text field). Default is off to reduce response size. Enable this if you need the transcript as a single text block. |
